answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 19114 Country: India Title: Naming baby boy with ?Aman? Question: Assalamu Alaikum, My name is Azeem I want to name my new born son as AMAN. Please let me know if the name which I we have choosen is a proper Islamic name and also want to no if my name is correct in Islamic terms. Answer ID: 19114 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 131/131/M=1431) ?Aman? means peace, tranquility, satisfaction, reconciliation etc, it has good meaning, you can keep it as name, but still it is better to name with ?Amanullah?. Your name ?Azim? is also alright. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
